new_today_news.headline: 15-Year SAF Deal For UK's Largest Regional Airline
new_today_news.summary: Loganair signed a 15-year offtake agreement with ClimaHtech Green Flight to secure sustainable aviation fuel using biomass and e-fuel technologies. The deal demonstrates growing international SAF market developments, though volumes remain small relative to overall jet fuel demand.

recent_news.headline: WSU study offers realistic look at the future of sustainable aviation fuel
recent_news.summary: A Washington State University study analyzes U.S. SAF production capacity and feedstock constraints, finding that domestic production could reach about 2.1 billion gallons annually by 2030—roughly two-thirds of the federal 3 billion gallon target. The research highlights a global shortage of used cooking oil and competition between SAF and renewable diesel producers for limited feedstocks.

recent_news.headline: Restaurant sales continued to rise in April, despite elevated gas prices
recent_news.summary: Restaurant sales continued to rise in April despite elevated gas prices. That included restaurants, which saw sales rise for the third consecutive month. Eating and drinking places registered total sales of $101.0 billion on a seasonally adjusted basis in April, up 0.6% from March.

recent_news.headline: CDL-Vacuum Driver - Waste Resource Management
recent_news.summary: Waste Resource Management (WRM) is hiring a CDL vacuum truck driver and operator for liquid waste collection and transport in Las Vegas. Role includes pre/post trip inspections, safety compliance, and loading/unloading liquid waste to treatment facilities. Compensation $28/hour plus performance bonuses, benefits, and career growth.
